title: Television Advertising and Online Shopping
authors: Jūra Liaukonytė; Thales S. Teixeira; Kenneth C. Wilbur
eligible_reason: No binary staggered DiD. Ad-level regressions of changes in website traffic and sales in two-minute (and two-hour, competitor-differenced) windows around each TV ad on continuous ad-content measures, spend by brand, and many program/pod/position controls; also 3SLS and 2SLS.
design_notes: ltw_estcode.do: reg direct_120/origin_se_120/count_trans_120 on std_argument1 std_dr std_emo std_sensory1 c.dols#i.b plus product, property, program-type, pod, position, week/dow/hour/minute effects; d_*_7200 outcomes difference against nonadvertising competitors; reg3 and ivregress 2sls.

screener_notes: No article text available locally; the abstract and code are sufficient to rule out a staggered design.
